Free forever — no paywalls Giving is completely optional

You’re already welcome here. Giving is completely optional. You do not have to give to stay, to read, or to come back tomorrow.

Verses, plans, prayer, and the study tools are already yours. Nothing is unlocked by a gift. If you ever want to help keep the porch open, you choose the amount—there is no suggested number. The shop is only merch, if you want it.

How the porch stays open

If this place helped you and you want to help the next person, you can give once or monthly—you choose the amount. There is no right size. A gift keeps teaching, free outreach packs, and the tools open. Leave it. Come back. Both are welcome.

What stays free

All of the Word and study tools stay free. Sign in only if you want notes on another device—never to open a door.
